categories.main_business_segments: Hangzhou Changchuan Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of specialized equipment for integrated circuits, focusing on semiconductor testing equipment including test machines, sorting machines, automation equipment, and AOI optical inspection devices. The company operates in three main business units: domestic operations, STI overseas operations, and EXIS overseas operations.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has mastered core technologies in integrated circuit testing equipment, including high-precision 2D/3D optical inspection (AOI), digital test machines, probe stations, and sorting machines. It emphasizes independent R&D with over 1000 patents and a strong in-house development team. Production involves order-based and inventory-based manufacturing, with some outsourced PCB and cable assembly.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading integrated circuit packaging and testing enterprises, wafer manufacturers, and chip design companies such as JCET, Huatian Technology, Tongfu Microelectronics, Silan Microelectronics, China Resources Microelectronics, and ASE. The company serves both domestic and international semiconductor manufacturers, including major IDM and foundry companies.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with significant presence in the Yangtze River Delta region, and overseas subsidiaries in Singapore, Malaysia, South Korea, the Philippines, Hong Kong, and Japan. It serves customers domestically and internationally, with overseas sales accounting for approximately 11.91% of revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: Changchuan Technology operates mainly in the midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain, providing specialized testing and sorting equipment essential for integrated circuit manufacturing and packaging processes.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes independent R&D and technological innovation, focusing on expanding product lines such as digital test machines, probe stations, and AOI equipment. It aims to deepen product specialization, broaden product breadth, and expand market reach domestically and internationally to break foreign monopolies and enhance competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of integrated circuit testing machines, sorting machines, and related equipment. The company uses a direct sales model, engaging customers via commercial negotiations and bidding, with revenue recognized upon delivery and acceptance of products or services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The semiconductor testing equipment market is dominated globally by foreign companies like Advantest, Teradyne, and Cohu. Changchuan Technology is among the leading domestic players achieving significant import substitution and competing increasingly in high-end segments, leveraging local advantages in service and cost-effectiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 3.64 billion, a 105.15% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 458 million, a 915.14% increase. The company has shown strong growth momentum, supported by increased R&D investment and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Changchuan Technology emphasizes high-performance, reliable, and cost-effective semiconductor testing equipment with strong customization capabilities. Its products have achieved domestic import substitution and are recognized for competitive pricing and technical innovation, supported by a robust R&D team and comprehensive after-sales service, particularly benefiting from proximity to major domestic semiconductor manufacturers.
